zh.title: 解读串谋分数之前，先看标签留下了谁
zh.summary: 严格标签同时读取目标投票与私有立场。混合信号被排除，缺失立场按非阳性处理；理解分数需要同时披露证据完整性与保留人群。

en.title: An Approval Prompt Is Only One Part of Delegated Authority
en.summary: Pinned source-function probes show how approval changes action disposition, while leaving caller identity, authority scope and policy coverage as separate evidentiary questions.
